newsitem.title: FINLAND: HACKMAN'S HADWACO HAS FIM 10 MLN ORDERS.
newsitem.headline: HACKMAN'S HADWACO HAS FIM 10 MLN ORDERS.

text.p: Finnish multibusiness group Oy Hackman Ab said on Wednesday its Hadwaco environmental technology unit had won equipment orders worth some 10 million markka in total.

Hadwaco sealed deals to deliver an evaporator unit worth six million markka to South African group DB Thermal (Pty) and to deliver two evaporator units worth four million markka to Finnish group Aquamax Oy, Hackman said in a statement.
The equipment sold to DB Thermal was destined for a water treatment plant being constructed for South African group Saldanha Steel, Hackman said.
Delivery would take place in October, it said.
DB Thermal (Pty) Ltd is part of the Deutsche Babcock group, it said.
The units sold to Aquamax would make drinking water out of seawater and would be delivered to Egypt and Singapore in September, Hackman said.
